items.reason: The investigational intervention is a device ('to test the feasibility of a Static Magnetic and Electric Field (sBE) Device when combined with standard chemotherapy drugs, Lomustine and Bevacizumab'); devices are an excluded intervention type (§1.2). Lomustine and bevacizumab are background (soc_backbone), not an established-therapy experiment, so established_therapy_only does not fit well.

note: The manual does not say which S6 reason applies when the only investigational intervention is a device and the only drugs are background established therapy; neither coder chose excluded_intervention_type, so XL should pick the convention. The choice is moot for Figure 1: the record is 'Phase: NA', so it fails S3 (phase_not_applicable) first.
